sources.name: Firmenbuch (Austrian Commercial Register) via JustizOnline
sources.verdict: Official register of all Austrian companies. Paid per query (current extract EUR 3.76, historical EUR 6.30 per usp.gv.at); no free bulk/open-data dump exists. Portal is a JS app (fetch returned only the shell). Data also flows through 10 BMJ-authorized Verrechnungsstellen.

sources.name: Firmenbuch clearing-house API (auszug.at, official Verrechnungsstelle)
sources.verdict: auszug.at (Wiener Zeitung Digitale Publikationen) is an authorized government clearing house since 2015 offering paid API access to Firmenbuch data/extracts. The machine route to Firmenbuch — paid per hit. Other API clearing houses: firmenabfrage.at, opendata.host, BREX/360kompany.

sources.name: OpenFirmenbuch (free unofficial Firmenbuch search)
sources.verdict: Free search of Austrian Firmenbuch core data (name, FN number, legal form, location) without registration. Unofficial third-party layer — useful for lookup/matching, not authoritative extracts. Found via search; not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: GISA — Gewerbeinformationssystem Austria (trade licence register)
sources.verdict: Free public query of all Austrian trade businesses (name, location, wording of trade authorization) since 2018, no registration, DE+EN. Confirmed via multiple official pages (wien.gv.at, usp.gv.at, bmwet.gv.at); site itself not fetched this run.

sources.name: ZVR — Zentrales Vereinsregister (central register of associations)
sources.verdict: Interior-ministry register of all Austrian Vereine (relevant for foundations/association-form vehicles). Free public Registerauszug query; zvr.bmi.gv.at/Start redirects here (302 verified).

sources.name: Grundbuch (land register) via JustizOnline / Verrechnungsstellen
sources.verdict: Land/mortgage register for real-asset ownership verification. Paid per query via JustizOnline or the same clearing houses as Firmenbuch. JustizOnline root verified reachable; the specific Grundbuch query path not individually verified.

sources.name: WiEReG — beneficial ownership register (BMF)
sources.verdict: Austrian UBO register. Public access is RESTRICTED post-CJEU (legitimate-interest extracts via USP, fee-based). Include for completeness; per project law, never assume open UBO data. URL not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: FMA Unternehmensdatenbank (licensed banks, insurers, AIFMs, investment firms)
sources.verdict: The authoritative Austrian licence database (all FMA-licensed entities incl. KAGs/AIFMs, Pensionskassen, Vorsorgekassen, insurers, crypto). WAF confirmed: EN search page returns 403 to our fetcher. Workaround: ESMA registers for AIFMs/UCITS/firms; OeNB lists for banks; WKO lists for pension/severance funds.

sources.name: FMA MiCAR/CASP supervision + crypto licensee information
sources.verdict: FMA licenses CASPs under MiCAR (regime live since 30 Dec 2024; ~12 VASP-registered providers transitioning). Licensees appear in the Unternehmensdatenbank — same WAF 403 applies. ESMA's MiCA interim register is the machine-readable fallback.

sources.name: ESMA Registers (AIFMs, UCITS, investment firms, MiCA — Austrian entities)
sources.verdict: EU-level registers with country filter AT — the practical machine route around the FMA WAF for AIFMs, management companies and investment firms. JS front-end but register datasets are downloadable/openly accessible; page verified reachable (app shell loads).

sources.name: OeNB — Listen Finanzinstitute (MFI and non-MFI lists)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: free CSV/ZIP downloads of Austrian MFIs and non-MFI credit institutions; investment funds and securitization vehicles (FVCs) delegated to ECB lists. Clean deterministic source for the banking/lender universe.

sources.name: OeNB — SEPA-Zahlungsverkehrs-Verzeichnis (bank master data, daily CSV)
sources.verdict: Daily-updated CSV of all Austrian credit institutions (bank codes, BICs, names); companion bank-branch directory on the SEPA-Verzeichnis page. Direct CSV URL surfaced by search; page confirmed, file itself not downloaded this run.

sources.name: ECB lists of financial institutions (AT investment funds, FVCs, MFIs)
sources.verdict: OeNB's own lists page delegates Austrian investment-fund and securitization-vehicle (FVC) lists to the ECB — full AT fund universe in downloadable datasets. Linked from verified OeNB page; ECB URL itself not fetched this run.

sources.name: Emissionshandelsregisterstelle Österreich (EU ETS registry office, Umweltbundesamt)
sources.verdict: Austrian part of the EU Union Registry, administered by Umweltbundesamt GmbH (account holders = installation operators + traders). Account data lives in the EU-wide Union Registry / EUTL; this site carries Austrian participant guidance and lists. Verified via search snippets.

sources.name: EVI — digital official gazette of the Republic of Austria (evi.gv.at)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: successor to the Amtsblatt zur Wiener Zeitung since 1 Jul 2023. Free access to Firmenbuch change publications, FMA warnings, insolvency creditor notices, AGM invitations, financial statements. No API/RSS advertised — HTML monitoring required.

sources.name: Ediktsdatei (court edicts database, justiz.gv.at)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED open: all court announcements, free, no registration. A signed IWG re-use agreement (bmj.gv.at PDF) exists for structured re-use of Ediktsdatei data — a legal bulk route worth pursuing. Core NPL/distressed signal source for AT.

sources.name: Insolvenzdatei (insolvency file, simple search)
sources.verdict: Exclusive publication venue for all Austrian insolvency proceedings (bankruptcies, restructurings, debt regulation). Free; data visible up to 1-3 years after close. Lotus-Notes-style URLs but HTML is parseable. URL confirmed via search results.

sources.name: Insolvenzverwalterliste (insolvency administrators) + data.gv.at API
sources.verdict: Public roll of Austrian insolvency administrators, searchable by industry/region; an official open-data API dataset exists on data.gv.at ('Liste der Insolvenzverwalter:innen', dataset id 0343b1ca-71c1-47c3-8ceb-db00b2a12e09). One data.gv.at path 404'd; the datasets-id URL from search is the live one.

sources.name: Gerichtssachverständigenliste (SDG list — court-certified experts incl. real-estate valuers)
sources.verdict: 8,100+ court-certified experts searchable by specialty and court district — the Austrian equivalent of a valuer directory ('Immobilien Bewertung' category). Free. Complements RICS which has no separate AT public roll.

sources.name: RIS — Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes
sources.verdict: Federal legal information system (laws, Bundesgesetzblatt, case law) with a documented OGD API on data.gv.at. Fetch returned 503 at check time (transient); the service is long-established.

sources.name: WKO Firmen A-Z (chamber of commerce company directory)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: free directory claiming all 625,292 Austrian companies (membership is mandatory in AT), searchable by name/industry/location. Excellent free matching/enrichment layer alongside the paid Firmenbuch.

sources.name: Wiener Börse — list of listed companies
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: all Austrian-listed issuers across prime/standard/global/direct market segments, filterable by ISIN/segment. Free CSV export was discontinued per exchange — HTML parsing required.

sources.name: Wiener Börse — trading member list
sources.verdict: Exchange member firms (execution brokers — service-graph category 4/6). URL confirmed from the exchange's own market-data navigation; page itself not fetched.

sources.name: Wiener Börse — listed debt securities
sources.verdict: Listed bonds incl. corporate/real-estate issuers (Vienna MTF is a significant CEE bond listing venue). URL confirmed from site navigation; not individually fetched.

sources.name: invest.austria (merged aaia + AVCO — PE/VC/business-angel association)
sources.verdict: Austria's PE/VC + angel association (350+ members) formed 2023 from AVCO and aaia merger — the canonical AT GP/angel directory. Member directory reportedly ingested already per task hint; site reachable.

sources.name: VÖIG — Vereinigung Österreichischer Investmentgesellschaften
sources.verdict: Umbrella body for 100% of Austrian investment-fund and real-estate-fund management companies (KAGs) — the AT ManCo universe. EFAMA member. Verified via search; legacy Lotus-Notes site, parseable.

sources.name: VÖL — Verband Österreichischer Leasing-Gesellschaften (member list)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: 43 member companies listed openly (≈94% of AT leasing new business, EUR 9.9bn 2025) — asset-backed-lending universe for category 2.

sources.name: VVO — Versicherungsverband Österreich (insurance association)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable: represents all private insurers operating in Austria (LP side). No member directory on homepage — member universe better sourced from FMA/OeNB; VVO-Newsroom useful for sector signals.

sources.name: Verband österreichischer Banken und Bankiers (Bankenverband)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: banking association with a Mitglieder (members) section and press area. Complements OeNB CSV lists with the association view.

sources.name: WKO — Liste der Pensionskassen
sources.verdict: The AT pension-fund universe is tiny and fully enumerable: 8 Pensionskassen under FMA supervision (5 multi-employer, 2-3 company). WKO Fachverband list confirmed via search; bypasses the FMA WAF.

sources.name: WKO — Vorsorgekassen in Österreich (severance funds)
sources.verdict: 7 betriebliche Vorsorgekassen (mandatory severance funds, ~EUR 20bn AUM class) — institutional allocators. URL confirmed via search.

sources.name: ÖRAK Anwaltsverzeichnis (Austrian bar — lawyer directory)
sources.verdict: National directory of 7,344 lawyers searchable by name/region/practice area — source for M&A/fund-structuring law firm mapping (category 6). Legacy ASP.NET search form; confirmed via search results.

sources.name: KSW Mitgliederverzeichnis (tax advisors & auditors chamber)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: chamber of Steuerberater/Wirtschaftsprüfer with public member search, 12,000+ entries (fund auditors, category 6). Directory at ksw.or.at/mitgliederverzeichnis/.

sources.name: Hauptverband der Gerichtssachverständigen — expert search
sources.verdict: Association-run search over court-certified experts (parallel to the official SDG list, friendlier interface). Surfaced and confirmed via search; not fetched this run.

sources.name: aws — Austria Wirtschaftsservice (federal promotional bank)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: 100% federally owned promotional bank; runs guarantees, seed programs and (via aws Gründerfonds) VC — co-investor appearing in AT deal flow. Funding-program pages parseable.

sources.name: OeEB — Oesterreichische Entwicklungsbank (development bank of Austria)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: publishes its project/investment list ('Our Projects at a Glance') and impact reports — DFI LP/lender active in emerging-market PE funds and infrastructure.

sources.name: OeKB — Oesterreichische Kontrollbank (export credit + CSD + capital-market data)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: ISIN allocation, government bond auctions, CSD (EUR 841bn custody), ESG Data Hub, fund data services — infrastructure node of the AT capital market and a data source for issuers/funds.

sources.name: ÖBAG — Österreichische Beteiligungs AG (state holding portfolio)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via homepage: manages 9 state shareholdings worth EUR 29.85bn (OMV, VERBUND, Post, Telekom, Casinos, BIG, APK Pensionskasse etc.) — the privatization/state-asset map. /beteiligungen/ 404s; /unser-portfolio/ is the correct path.

sources.name: ABA — Austrian Business Agency (Invest in Austria)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: federal investment-promotion agency with sector intelligence, success stories (FDI signals) and a News/Events/Press section.

sources.name: data.gv.at — Austrian open data portal (incl. procurement Kerndaten)
sources.verdict: CKAN portal with API. Since 1 Mar 2019 ALL Austrian procurement notices/awards >= EUR 50k must publish core data (Kerndaten) metadata here in machine-readable open format — the national procurement feed. Also hosts justice datasets (e.g. insolvency administrators API).

sources.name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (Austria filter)
sources.verdict: Above-threshold AT tenders and contract awards (infrastructure/concession signals) with an open API and bulk downloads. Standard EU source; not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Statistik Austria
sources.verdict: Business demography, insolvency statistics, FDI and sector data via STATcube and open data downloads. Well-known official source; not fetch-verified this run.

sources.name: Der Standard — Wirtschaft RSS
sources.verdict: VERIFIED working RSS 2.0 feed (~30 items, Austrian corporate news: OMV, RBI, Erste, BAWAG, insolvencies). Top-quality AT business signal feed.

sources.name: Die Presse — Wirtschaft
sources.verdict: Leading quality daily with strong economy/finance desk. Our fetcher is blocked at the domain level; the documented RSS URL is recorded but could NOT be verified from this environment — retest from production IPs.

sources.name: brutkasten — startup/VC media
sources.verdict: VERIFIED working RSS (hourly; funding rounds, acquisitions, fund launches — e.g. Highland Europe EUR 1.1bn fund). Primary AT venture signal source.

sources.name: Trending Topics — tech/startup media
sources.verdict: VERIFIED working WordPress RSS ('The Techcrunch of Austria'); AT/CEE startup funding coverage. Note domain migrated from .at to .eu.

sources.name: ORF News
sources.verdict: VERIFIED RSS 1.0 feed, hourly, incl. economy stories. Broad national wire — useful for insolvency/major-deal breaking news.

sources.name: Kurier — Wirtschaft
sources.verdict: Major daily with economy section. Domain refuses our fetcher; RSS endpoint could not be located/verified from this environment.

sources.name: APA-OTS — press release distribution (Wirtschaft/Finanzen channels)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable: APA-Comm platform carrying 1.5m+ releases incl. corporate ad-hoc and fund announcements, channelized (Wirtschaft, Finanzen). /rss/ returns 404 and no public feed index is advertised — channel pages are parseable HTML; per-keyword RSS appears to require registration.

sources.name: Börse Express
sources.verdict: Austrian stock-market news portal (Vienna-listed issuers, ad-hoc commentary). Returned 403 to our fetcher; retest from production infrastructure.

sources.name: Institutional Money
sources.verdict: Austrian-published magazine for institutional investors (pension funds, insurers — the LP discourse). Hard GDPR consent wall (pay-or-accept) blocks unauthenticated fetching; publisher FONDS professionell Multimedia GmbH.

sources.name: FONDS professionell Österreich
sources.verdict: Fund-industry trade publication (AT edition), same publisher as Institutional Money — expect the same consent wall. Not fetch-verified this run; include for evaluation.

sources.name: e-fundresearch.com
sources.verdict: Vienna-based fund/asset-management news portal. Both homepage and /feed returned 403 to our fetcher — retest from production IPs.

sources.name: immoflash (IMMOBILIEN Magazin / Immomedien)
sources.verdict: Daily Austrian real-estate news (deals, developers, funds) — category 3 signals. Old immoflash.at/feed 302-redirects here (verified); no working RSS found at new domain.

sources.name: trend. — business weekly
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable: executive business magazine (companies, finance, Top 500 ranking, trend.invest). No RSS link visible; offers 'trend. daily' email newsletter — HTML parsing needed.

sources.name: FMA — news & press releases
sources.verdict: Enforcement actions, investor warnings, licence decisions, quarterly pension/severance-fund reports. Same WAF 403 as the rest of fma.gv.at from our fetcher; warnings are republished on EVI (open) as a partial workaround.

sources.name: OeNB — media/press page
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: press releases on financial stability, banking statistics, monetary policy. No RSS visible — HTML monitoring of the press archive.

sources.name: BMF — Finanzministerium press
sources.verdict: Ministry announcements (tax, capital-market policy, WiEReG). URL not fetch-verified this run — confirm exact press path on ingestion.

sources.name: Der Börsianer
sources.verdict: Austrian capital-markets magazine (banking, insurance, funds rankings). Known publication but URL not fetch-verified this run — verify before ingestion.

sources.name: Wiener Börse — news & official announcements
sources.verdict: Exchange news plus legally required announcements at /en/legal/announcements/ (both URLs confirmed from the exchange's own navigation). Issuer ad-hoc disclosures also flow via euro adhoc (APA-OTS).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Covers the larger Austrian GPs/LPs (Erste/RBI asset-management arms, insurers, Pensionskassen as LPs) and pan-European funds with AT exposure; thin on AT lower-mid-market, NPL servicers, and the service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FMA licence disclosures, ESMA registers, fund annual reports, association data (Invest Europe, which invest.austria feeds), press releases — all reachable directly via FMA/ESMA/OTS.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: AT PE/VC deal and valuation coverage via press + filings; good on buyouts of Austrian Mittelstand by DACH sponsors; weak on private-debt and real-asset vehicles.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Firmenbuch filings (via commercial clearing-house data), APA-OTS press releases, Wiener Börse disclosures, EVI gazette publications — we can go to justizonline/auszug.at, ots.at, wienerborse.at, evi.gv.at directly.

competitorAnalysis.platform: Dealroom (global; local flavor via vienna.dealroom.co with Vienna Business Agency)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong Vienna/AT startup + VC round coverage through the co-branded Vienna ecosystem instance (fetch returned 403 — actively bot-protected; do not scrape).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: brutkasten, Trending Topics, der Standard startup coverage, invest.austria member data, founders' self-reporting, Firmenbuch capital-increase filings — the press feeds and Firmenbuch route are directly available to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow AT startup coverage, mostly self-reported profiles plus funding press; unreliable for legal-entity ground truth.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company self-submissions and English-language tech press; underlying verifiable layer is the same AT press (brutkasten/TT) + Firmenbuch we ingest directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: 640,000 AT companies with payment history, insolvencies, register data; membership/paywall model; the local ground-truth standard for creditworthiness and insolvency stats.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Firmenbuch (clearing-house feed), Ediktsdatei/Insolvenzdatei (open!), GISA, EVI gazette — every underlying register is public and independently ingestable by us; their proprietary layer is payment-experience data.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Same category as KSV1870: credit reports, insolvency trend statistics (their semi-annual insolvency studies are themselves a public signal worth monitoring).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Firmenbuch, Ediktsdatei, GISA, financial statements filed to Firmenbuch — all reachable directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Aggregates Firmenbuch, Grundbuch, GISA, Vereinsregister, WiEReG, insolvencies and balance sheets into one paid platform with a real API (api.wirtschaftscompass.at); from EUR 24/yr entry tier. The closest local analogue to an entity-data backbone.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Exactly the tier-1/3 registers in this catalog (Firmenbuch, Grundbuch, GISA, ZVR, Ediktsdatei, EVI) — validates our source map; we ingest the same registers directly rather than their platform.

competitorAnalysis.platform: Dun & Bradstreet Austria (ex-Bisnode) + firm directories (FirmenABC, HEROLD)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Commercial firmographics and marketing data on AT companies; FirmenABC/HEROLD are ad-financed directories with SEO-visible company pages.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Firmenbuch clearing-house data, WKO Firmen A-Z, GISA — the free WKO and GISA layers give us equivalent breadth at $0.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but confirmed absent or unusable: (1) a free/open-data bulk dump of the Firmenbuch — does not exist; access is per-query paid via JustizOnline or the 10 authorized Verrechnungsstellen (APIs exist but are paid); (2) Wiener Börse free CSV issuer export — explicitly discontinued by the exchange (HTML lists remain); (3) a public OTS RSS index — /rss/ returns 404; per-channel/keyword RSS appears registration-gated; (4) FMA machine access of any kind — the WAF 403 confirmed on fma.gv.at (company database, MiCAR pages, news alike); ESMA registers + OeNB CSVs + WKO lists are the workarounds; (5) a standalone Austrian carbon-account list — Austrian ETS accounts live inside the EU Union Registry/EUTL, with only guidance at emissionshandelsregister.at; (6) open UBO data — WiEReG public access is restricted post-CJEU (legitimate-interest, fee-based); (7) a dedicated NPL/servicer register — no such AT register exists; the lender universe must be assembled from OeNB lists + FMA licences + Ediktsdatei activity; (8) a separate RICS Austria public directory — Austrian valuers are best covered by the open Gerichtssachverständigenliste; (9) WirtschaftsBlatt (former financial daily) — defunct since 2016; (10) RSS for Die Presse, Kurier, Börse Express, e-fundresearch — all four domains block or refuse our fetcher, so their feeds are recorded as unverified and must be retested from production infrastructure. Web-search budget for this session was exhausted near the end; ÖBAG/aws/OeEB/KSW/RIS rows were verified by direct fetch instead, and items marked 'not fetch-verified' are flagged honestly in their verdicts.
